WITH latest AS (
    SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, MAX(DateKey) AS max_date
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        i.ProductKey,
        sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS total_on_hand,
        sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS total_safety_stock
    FROM retail.FactInventory i
    JOIN latest
        ON i.StoreKey = latest.StoreKey
       AND i.ProductKey = latest.ProductKey
       AND i.DateKey = latest.max_date
    GROUP BY i.ProductKey
)
SELECT
    ci.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    ci.total_on_hand,
    ci.total_safety_stock,
    ci.total_safety_stock - ci.total_on_hand AS shortage
FROM current_inventory ci
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON ci.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE ci.total_on_hand < ci.total_safety_stock
ORDER BY shortage DESC
